subject: Discovery — inference integration & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@wellpathhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery — inference integration & onboarding plan

Thanks again for the intro call earlier, Olga. Quick write-up from my side to capture the high-level needs and what I heard. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Pain points we shared
- Current on-prem inference is slow at >500ms/token for our triage model, causing backlog in clinician queues.
- Costs for peak traffic spikes are unpredictable; we want predictable unit economics for chat endpoints.
- Need data isolation and audit logs for regulated records (HIPAA + internal audit).

Current stack
- Model: fine-tuned Llama-2 family (30B-ish) served on mixed GPU infra (NVIDIA A100 + some CPU fallbacks)
- API layer: internal gateway that expects REST/JSON, supports server-side batching but no KV-cache today
- SDKs in use: Python (main), Java (backend), a small Node.js web app for experiments

Success criteria for PoC (Q3 target)
- Latency: median per-token < 120ms for our typical 512-token streams
- Cost: demonstrable 30% reduction per-inference vs current baseline at target throughput
- Security: SOC2-equivalent controls and support for our KMS for key rotation

Immediate asks from our side
1) Can you share a PoC blueprint (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)?
2) Which SDKs and API compatibility patterns will be required to avoid a big rewrite?
3) What telemetry / traces do you surface for latency/cost analysis?
4) Security questionnaire will be sent from procurement — who should receive it?

I can loop in procurement after we have the PoC milestones. Looking forward to the plan.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of ML Platforms
WellPath Health

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — inference integration & onboarding plan

Samira — thanks for the thorough summary, that matches my notes. Below is a concise PoC blueprint and integration map to get us to a technical kickoff.

PoC blueprint (high level)
- Week 0 (prep): exchange security questionnaire, whitelist IPs, create test dataset (anonymized 200 transcripts) — owner: WellPath (Samira) / Redwood (Olga)
- Week 1: Sandbox deploy of model variant on Redwood hosted Dedicated; verify SDK connectivity (Python + Java) and basic token accounting — owner: Marcus
- Week 2: Latency tuning: batching and KV-cache experiments on representative traffic; capture perf/cost tradeoffs — owner: Marcus
- Week 3: End-to-end validation, run acceptance prompts, cost/latency reporting; decide rollout plan for production — owners: Neha + Samira

Integration notes
- SDKs: we provide production-ready Python and Java SDKs (same API surface). Node.js can call the REST endpoint with identical semantics. We'll share compatibility docs (attached).
- API compatibility: standard REST + streaming websocket; request/response schema will match your gateway with only minor adapters.
- Telemetry: token-level latency, per-route cost, traceable request IDs, KV-cache hit rates; export to your Datadog/CloudWatch via our tracing hooks.

Success criteria (aligned)
- Median token latency target: <120ms for 512 tokens (measured on your sample workload)
- Cost target: ~30% reduction with batching + quantization (measured in our Week 2 experiments)
- Security: KMS integration + audit logs enabled for PoC environment

Proposed immediate next steps
1) I attached the PoC matrix (redwood_poc_matrix.xlsx) and SDK compatibility notes (redwood_sdk_compatibility.md).
2) Please send the security questionnaire to security@redwood.ai (I copied Marcus for SRE intake).
3) Can we schedule a 60-min technical kickoff next week? Proposed windows: Jul 19 10am PT or Jul 20 11am PT.

I'll also open a HubSpot deal and calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions — Redwood Inference
security@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood_poc_matrix.xlsx, redwood_sdk_compatibility.md
